items.title: Why Is JNJ Stock Beating Rivals That Grow Faster?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) stock has returned 58% over the past twelve months, second best in a group of six health care companies. Its revenue growth ranks only fourth of the six. Three peers grew faster and returned less, Eli Lilly among them. The price is a bet that the rest of the business keeps growing once shrinking STELARA sales stop dragging on the total.

items.title: How Far Can BSX Stock Swing After Losing More Than Half Its Value?
items.summary: Boston Scientific (BSX) stock has fallen 55.5% over the past twelve months, and at $43.72 it trades barely above its 52-week low of $42.63. The options market now prices a likely one-year range from $28.46 to $67.16 a share. That band is wide, but it is close to how much the stock has already been moving.

items.title: 3 Defensive Dividend Stocks For Steady Income as Fed Pressure Builds

items.title: How Far Could ISRG Stock Bounce From Here?
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) stock could climb 23.9% to the April high it last fell back from, and you would risk about 5% to find out. That looks like a surgical-robot leader on sale, but the price history disagrees. Over the last two years, none of its visits to this price range turned into a 20% gain before a 5% drop.

items.title: What Does Medtronic (MDT) FDA Clearance Mean For Its Hugo Surgery Push?
items.summary: Medtronic (NYSE:MDT) received FDA clearance for its LigaSure vessel-sealing device on the Hugo robotic surgery system in the U.S. The authorization allows LigaSure to be used on the Hugo platform for soft-tissue procedures in U.S. hospitals and surgical centers. The cleared configuration integrates a widely used vessel-sealing tool with Medtronic’s robotic-assisted surgery platform for general surgery use.
